note: Which crawls constitute the historical series. This is methodology: adding or removing a crawl changes the series, so the list is data rather than a command-line argument.
selection: Roughly quarterly from January 2023 to August 2026. Quarterly rather than every crawl because the question is the shape of the rise — a step at GPTBot's launch in August 2023, or a steady climb — and a quarter of the requests answers it. Denser coverage can be added later; the collector is resumable and skips crawls already gathered.
period_source: Common Crawl's own name for each crawl; where a crawl spans two months the earlier is used.
